title: Machine learning predicts wear in carbon-fiber polypropylene composites
summary: In an L25 experimental design varying carbon-fiber and polypropylene composition and operating conditions, an SVM achieved a test R² of 0.9362 for wear prediction. The experiments also found the 15 wt.% carbon-fiber composition had the lowest measured wear. The study is small and reports no independent materials validation.
ai_technology: Support-vector machine for composite wear prediction

evidence.tested: The study used an L25 experimental design, assessed SVM wear predictions on a held-out test set (R²=0.9362), and measured the lowest wear at 15 wt.% carbon fiber.
evidence.unknown: The study uses a small experimental design and does not report independent materials validation.
evidence.ai_role: The SVM predicts composite wear from composition and operating variables; the experimental design supplies measured wear outcomes.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
